title: Train AI to write in your voice with UmanWrite for $63.20
excerpt: Make AI-assisted writing sound a little more like you.
content_html:
TL;DR: UmanWrite’s lifetime Unlimited Plan is on sale for $63.20 (reg. $1,799) through Sept. 20 at 11:59 p.m. PT, with unlimited monthly words and personalized AI writing tools.

Credit: UmanWrite

$63.20
$1,799 Save $1,735.80

AI can make writing a first draft easier, but the result doesn’t always sound like something you would actually write. UmanWrite Premium takes a more personalized approach, allowing you train the platform on your own writing samples so future drafts can better match your tone, vocabulary and style. The lifetime UmanWrite Premium Unlimited Plan is on sale for $63.20 (reg. $1799) through Sept. 20 at 11:59 p.m. PT, use code SAVE20.

UmanWrite lets you create unlimited Voice Profiles using your own writing samples. Its context-aware writing tools can then adapt content to your intended audience, purpose, and preferred style. There’s also an AI Humanizer designed to make AI-generated text read more naturally, plus an AI Detector for checking drafts for patterns associated with AI-generated writing.

The program also serves as a complete writing and editing workspace. The Advanced Grammar Checker improves grammar, clarity, and readability, and the Writing Studio brings all your drafting and editing tools together. With the Unlimited Plan, you get unlimited monthly word generation and can make requests for up to 2,500 words at a time.

These features are useful for anyone who works with different types of writing. Freelancers can set up a Voice Profile for their client projects, and marketers can create content for various audiences. Businesses can use them for emails, newsletters, and other documents. The platform also helps with SEO articles, social media posts, and sales copy.

The main advantage is that you can create a writing profile based on your own style instead of using a generic AI voice. Plus, since the plan is a one-time purchase, you won’t need to pay for another monthly writing subscription.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

For writers who want AI assistance without completely giving up their own voice, UmanWrite offers a broad collection of tools in one platform. Get the lifetime Unlimited Plan while it’s price-dropped to $63.20 (reg. $1799) through Sept. 20 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
